blocks.prompt: 5 Find the gradient and equation of the tangent line to \(y = 3x^2 - 4x + 1\) at \(x = 2\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh tangent line ka sawal hai. Tangent line woh seedhi line hai jo curve ko us point par sirf chhooti hai aur wahan curve jaisi hi dhalaan rakhti hai.
Humein do cheezen chahiye: gradient \(f'(2)\) aur point \((2, f(2))\). Phir point-slope form se equation.
Plan: Exercise 13.1 mein rules abhi nahi aaye, is liye \(f'(x)\) definition ke chaar steps se nikalenge, phir \(x = 2\) rakhenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(f(x) = 3x^2 - 4x + 1\), \(x_1 = 2\).
Find karna hai: gradient \(f'(2)\) aur tangent line.
Tareeqa: definition (first principles / ab-initio, yani bilkul shuru se) se derivative: \(f'(x) = \lim_{\delta x \to 0} \frac{f(x + \delta x) - f(x)}{\delta x}\). Chaar steps yaad rakhein: (I) \(f(x + \delta x)\) likhein; (II) us mein se \(f(x)\) minus karein; (III) \(\delta x\) se divide karein; (IV) \(\delta x \to 0\) ka limit lein. Yeh tareeqa is liye ke Exercise 13.1 mein sawal khud 'by definition' maangta hai, aur power rule waghera abhi Section 13.6 mein aaenge; is liye shortcut nahi, poora limit ka safar dikhana hai. Kisi point par tangent ki gradient (slope / dhalaan) \(m = f'(x_1)\) hoti hai, aur tangent line ki equation point-slope form se: \(y - y_1 = m(x - x_1)\), jahan \(y_1 = f(x_1)\). Yaani humein teen cheezen chahiye: point ka \(x\), point ka \(y\), aur slope.

Step I aur II: \(f(x + \delta x) - f(x)\)
\[f(x + \delta x) = 3(x + \delta x)^2 - 4(x + \delta x) + 1\]
\[= 3x^2 + 6x\,\delta x + 3(\delta x)^2 - 4x - 4\,\delta x + 1\]
\[f(x + \delta x) - f(x) = 6x\,\delta x + 3(\delta x)^2 - 4\,\delta x\]
Kyun: Har \(x\) ki jagah \(x + \delta x\) rakha aur brackets khole; \(3\) poore square ko aur \(-4\) dono terms ko multiply karta hai. Phir \(f(x)\) minus kiya to \(3x^2\), \(-4x\) aur \(1\) cancel ho gaye.

Step III aur IV: divide aur limit
\[\dfrac{f(x + \delta x) - f(x)}{\delta x} = 6x + 3\,\delta x - 4\]
\[f'(x) = \lim_{\delta x \to 0}(6x + 3\,\delta x - 4) = 6x - 4\]
Kyun: Har term se ek \(\delta x\) cancel hua (abhi \(\delta x \neq 0\)). Phir \(\delta x = 0\) rakha to \(3\,\delta x\) chala gaya.

\(x = 2\) par gradient
\[m = f'(2) = 6(2) - 4 = 8\]
Kyun: Tangent ki slope wohi hai jo us point par derivative ki value hai. \(6 \times 2 - 4 = 8\).

Point of tangency (chhoone ka point)
\[y_1 = f(2) = 3(4) - 4(2) + 1 = 5\]
\[(x_1, y_1) = (2, 5)\]
Kyun: Line ki equation ke liye point ka \(y\) bhi chahiye; woh original function mein \(x = 2\) rakh kar milta hai, derivative mein nahi. Yeh aam ghalti hai: \(y_1\) ke liye \(f\) use karein, \(f'\) nahi.

Tangent ki equation
\[y - 5 = 8(x - 2)\]
\[y - 5 = 8x - 16\]
\[y = 8x - 11\]
Kyun: Point-slope form \(y - y_1 = m(x - x_1)\) mein \(m = 8\), \((x_1, y_1) = (2, 5)\) rakha, phir bracket khol kar \(y\) ko akela kiya.

Tasdeeq
\[x = 2:\ y = 8(2) - 11 = 5 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Line mein \(x = 2\) rakha to \(y = 5\) aaya, yani line sach mein curve ke point se guzarti hai, aur us ki slope \(8\) hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key \(8,\ y = 8x + 13\) chhapti hai. Gradient \(8\) sahi hai, lekin line ghalat hai: \(x = 2\) par yeh \(y = 29\) deti hai, jab ke curve ka point \((2, 5)\) hai, yani yeh line curve ko chhooti hi nahi. Sahi tangent \(y = 8x - 11\) hai.
